introduction:
A Death Certificate in Delhi is issued by the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD), New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC), or Delhi Cantonment Board depending on the area of occurrence. It is governed by the Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969.

This certificate is mandatory for insurance claims, property mutation, bank account settlement, pension/gratuity processing, and succession proceedings. Delhi offers online registration through the e-District Delhi portal and the CRS portal.
quickFacts:
Important to Know
  • State: Delhi
  • Issuing Authority: Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD)
  • Platform: MCD Online Portal (mcdonline.nic.in)
  • Time Limit for Free Registration: Within 21 days of the occurrence of death.
  • Late Registration Fees:
    • Between 21 days to 1 month: ₹2 (Requires written permission from the Registrar)
    • Between 1 month to 1 year: ₹5
    • After 1 year: ₹10 (Requires an order from the Area Magistrate/SDM)
  • Processing Time: Approximately 7 to 20 working days after successful submission.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required

Note: Keep scanned copies (max 2 MB per file in PDF/JPG format) or physical copies ready.
Proof of Death
  • Cremation/Burial Ground Receipt OR FIR/MLC/DD/General Diary/Death Summary.
  • Death Supporting Form (Form 4A): Especially required for non-institutional/home deaths, usually certified by a local authority or Village Pradhan.
Identity Proofs
  • Deceased's ID Proof: Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, PAN Card, etc.
  • Informant/Applicant's ID Proof: Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, etc.
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Apply Online via MCD Portal

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Step 1: Visit the Portal: Go to the official website: mcdonline.nic.in.
  2. Step 2: Navigate to Services: Click on "Online Services" from the top menu, then select "Registration of Birth & Death (RBD)".
  3. Step 3: Sign Up (For New Users): Click on "Citizen Login" and then click on "New User Click Here For Sign Up Registration". Fill in your First Name, Last Name, Gender, Email ID, Age, and Mobile Number. Click "Get OTP", enter the received OTP, type the Captcha, and click "Submit" to create your account.
  4. Step 4: Login: Go back to the login page, enter your registered Mobile Number, verify via OTP, enter the Captcha, and click "Login".
  5. Step 5: Start Application: On the dashboard, click on "Apply Birth / Still Birth / Death Registration". Select the "Death Registration" radio button and click "Continue".
  6. Step 6: Fill Form No. 2 (Death Registration):
    • Legal Information: Enter the Cremation Slip Number, Date of Cremation, Exact Date and Time of Death, Gender, Full Name of the deceased, Aadhaar (UID) number, Age at the time of death, Religion, and Occupation.
    • Medical Details: Specify the type of medical attention received before death, whether the cause was medically certified, and the actual disease/cause of death.
    • Parent/Spouse Details: Enter the names of the Mother, Father (mandatory), and Spouse (if applicable).
  7. Step 7: Address Details:
    • Place of Death: Select "House Address" (for home death) or "Other Place" (for hospitals) and provide the exact location address.
    • Provide the "Deceased's Present Address" and "Deceased's Permanent Address".
  8. Step 8: Informant Details: Enter the Applicant's Name, Relation to the deceased (e.g., Son, Father), Mobile Number, and full Address.
  9. Step 9: User Remark: Provide a short remark stating the reason for applying for the certificate.
  10. Step 10: Upload Documents: Upload the Cremation Slip, Deceased's ID, Informant's ID, and the Death Supporting Form (Form 4A) in their respective slots.
  11. Step 11: Submit & Pay: Click on "Submit" and confirm the details. If you are applying after 21 days, a payment prompt will appear. Click on "Proceed for Payment", select a payment gateway (HDFC/Axis/ICICI), choose your method (UPI, Card, Netbanking), and pay the late fee (e.g., ₹10).
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Apply Offline

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Step 1: Visit the Local Office: Go to the MCD Zonal Office, Citizen Service Centre (CSC), or the local Registrar of Births and Deaths office under whose jurisdiction the death occurred.
  2. Step 2: Obtain the Form: Request Form No. 2 (Death Registration Form) from the inquiry counter.
  3. Step 3: Fill & Attach: Fill out the form completely. Attach self-attested photocopies of the deceased's ID, informant's ID, the original cremation/burial slip, and the medical death report (or Form 4A for home deaths).
  4. Step 4: Submit the Application: Submit the form and documents at the registration counter. If applying after 21 days, you will be required to pay the applicable late fee. If applying after one year, you must first obtain a written order from the Area Magistrate (SDM).
  5. Step 5: Acknowledgment: Collect the acknowledgment slip provided by the official, which you will use to track and collect the final certificate.
afterApplying:
After Applying - Next Steps & Certificate Download

Verification Process

After successful submission (online or offline), the application goes to the concerned registrar for verification. This process typically takes around 7 to 20 working days.

Track Status

You can track your online application by logging into your MCD dashboard and clicking on the "Approved" tab or checking "Search Old Data & Print Certificate".

Download Certificate

Once the verification is successful, the status will update to "CERTIFICATE GENERATED". Click on the "Action" dropdown next to your application and select "Download Certificate" to save and print your digitally signed official Death Certificate.

Correcting Errors

If there are errors in your application, you can use the same "Action" menu to select "Correct Details".
